description: Refinements based on user feedback: bold display font for hero, rename NEXUS to RudraThings, fix testimonial card shadows, update address to Hyderabad, update copyright.
steps: Add Playfair Display bold/display font via Google Fonts in index.html and configure in tailwind.config.js
Apply the display font to hero headline for dramatic bold typography
Replace all instances of NEXUS with RudraThings throughout the codebase
Fix testimonial card overlapping dark shadows
Update contact address from San Francisco to Hyderabad, India with matching phone and email
Update copyright in footer from NEXUS to RudraThings
Run npm run build to verify changes compile cleanly
acceptance_criteria: Hero headline uses a bold display/serif font that is visually dramatic
All references to NEXUS are replaced with RudraThings
Testimonial cards have no duplicate/overlapping dark shadows
Contact section shows Hyderabad address with Indian phone number and RudraThings email
